document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Despite the risks and your weakened condition, you diverge 
from the direct route to Fort McDonald, determined to explore 
as much of the valley as possible before you quit.

To strike deep into the forest, go to 501. To hug the tree line, go to 
494. To explore rocky environs, go to 427. To stick to the river, make 
a Luck roll: if you succeed, go to 126; if you fail, go to 119.
